meta.name: CCNL RSA e Strutture Residenziali Socio-Assistenziali (AIOP)
meta.sector: residenze sanitarie assistenziali — personale non medico

sources.title: Original CCNL signed 22/03/2012, effective 01/04/2012. Art. 49 salary table, Art. 51 hourly divisor, Art. 54 tredicesima.
Accordo ponte 03/10/2023, effective 01/10/2023, valid to 30/06/2024. Full salary table confirmed.
AIOP RSA bridge agreement signed 3 October 2023, ratified 24 October 2023

notes.text: CCNL T091 — AIOP RSA. Conglobated. 12 levels: A-B-C-D1-D2-D3-E1-E2-E3-F-G-H. Divisor 165, 13 months. Original 2012 contract, updated by accordo ponte Oct 2023.
Accordo ponte (Oct 2023) expired June 2024. Contract applied in ultrattività pending renewal. Oct 2023 table modeled as current (valid_until null).

Apprenticeship: CCNL RSA-AIOP specifies sotto-inquadramento up to 2 levels below destination (levels A-F eligible, 36 months). Modelled as 100% passthrough (overstates pay for apprentices); the engine supports under_classification tracks with levels_below, not yet used here. (review of 2026-10-30)

limitation.remediation: Replace the 100% professionalizzante track with under_classification tracks (levels_below up to 2, 36 months) as servizi-postali-appalto-fise or tessile-smi do.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: Seniority: CCNL RSA-AIOP provides a flat EUR 40/month after 5 years of service (levels A-E3 only; F/G/H excluded). Modelled as cadence_months=60, maximum_count=1 — correct for new hires (single increment at month 60). The separate October 2023 seniority premium is modelled for employees with ten years at the same employer or group at signing (3 October 2023), using the caller-supplied employment start date as the start of group service. Earlier service at another group company must be reflected in that date; without a known start date the premium is not paid. Ratification is confirmed by the signed AIOP copy. The premium clause does not separately state a start date; 1 October 2023 is inferred from the agreement's effective date. No later replacement agreement has been verified; the 2023 agreement provides for continuation or annual renewal pending replacement, so the allowance remains open-ended pending evidence of a later change or absorption.

limitation.remediation: Supply group-service start as the employment start date when earlier service with another group company qualifies. Verify any separately specified premium start date and any later replacement or absorption before changing the open-ended premium.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

source_document.title: 1° Contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro per il personale dipendente delle RSA e delle altre strutture residenziali e socio-assistenziali associate AIOP 22 marzo 2012

location.quote: Nel caso di inizio o di cessazione del rapporto di lavoro durante il corso dell'anno, il lavoratore ha diritto a tanti dodicesimi dell'ammontare della tredicesima mensilità quanti sono i mesi di anzianità di servizio. La frazione di mese superiore a 15 giorni va considerata, a questi effetti, come mese intero.

provenance.transformation: Fractions of a month of more than 15 days count as a whole month.

fixed_allowances.description: Seniority premium for ten years of employer or group service at signing

source_document.title: AIOP RSA bridge agreement signed 3 October 2023, ratified 24 October 2023

location.quote: Si conviene che a tutti i dipendenti appartenenti ai livelli A, B, C, D1, D2, D3, E1, E2, E3, che, alla data di sottoscrizione del presente accordo, abbiano già maturato dieci anni di anzianità nella stessa Azienda o Gruppo compete un importo lordo pari a € 40,00 da erogarsi per tredici mensilità ed utile ai fini del TFR.

provenance.transformation: EUR 40 per monthly payment for the listed levels, including the thirteenth and TFR, from 1 October 2023. Signing was 3 October 2023 (PDF p. 7); ten years by signing means group service started by 3 October 2013. The caller supplies group-service start as employment start; unknown start does not qualify. The agreement is ratified (p. 12) and renews or continues pending replacement (p. 8); no later replacement is verified.
